item.title: How To Assign Honeycomb Bravo Buttons FBW A320 In MSFS2020
item.description:
Introduction

The Bravo Throttle from Honeycomb is an amazing tool for MSFS2020, but I always felt a little frustrated with the lack of button customization options in the sim, especially when it came to the A320.

GA flying with the bravo has been great, most of the button options can be assigned directly within the sim. However, I also enjoy flying airliners and I want to use the unassigned buttons on the Bravo Throttle to remove the need for mouse clicks when making common changes during a flight. Mainly, Selected / Managed Heading mode, Vertical Speed mode, and Selected / Managed Speed mode.

item.title: Making a flight plan with Pilot2ATC
item.description: Pliot2ATC is a companion program that connects to MSFS2020 (and other sims) providing a more realistic and immersive Air Traffic Control (ATC). The in-game ATC is universally known to be awful and I came across Pilot2ATC while looking for alternatives. It is available as a 10 day trial from https://pilot2atc.com/. The author encourages using the trial period to get familiar with the software before you buy the full version, which will set you back $59.95 US.

item.title: Microsoft Flight Sim 2020 Garmin G1000 Track Up / North Up
item.description:
The G1000 map orientation defaults to North Up. You can check the current orientation at the top right of the MFD screen.
The orientation can be changed in the MFD menu.

Follow these steps to change:

  1. On the MFD, click the Menu button.

  1. On the Map Options screen, click the ENT button.

  1. On the Orientation screen, click the ENT button.

item.title: MSFS2020 Boeing 787 Horizon Full Flight Tutorial
item.description:
Introduction

Welcome to my MSFS Boeing 787 Full Flight Tutorial, I am using the Horizon mod for this so if you are using the default 787 or other mod, some items may be a little different but you should still be able to follow along.

We are going to begin cold and dark at Hakodate Airport in Hokkaido, Japan. I will go through the start up procedures and show how to enter and check a flight plan, set the performance for the flight and show you my flows and checklists.

item.title: MSFS2020 ILS Landings Guide - Garmin 1000
item.description:
If you have been trying to perform an ILS landing using an aircraft equipped with the Garmin 1000 on Microsoft Flight Sim 2020 then there is a good chance that it hasn’t been working. Fortunately, I have a solution. Follow my guide below and you should be happily landing using the ILS system.

Create The Flight Plan

Step 1 is to create the flight plan in the World Map. In the example I used for this guide, I select LSMP as the departure and LSGG as the arrival. The flight plan will default to Direct-GPS, please change this to Low-altitude airways.
